# DumbJ keymap

<!-- Generated from keymaps/ by dumbj-actions. Do not edit by hand. -->

Linux uses the `DumbJ` keymap (IntelliJ's `macOS For All` plus DumbJ's own actions) and macOS uses `DumbJ macOS` (IntelliJ's `Mac OS X 10.5+` plus the same actions).

| Action | DumbJ ID | IntelliJ ID | Linux | macOS |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open Folder… | `project.open-folder` | `OpenFile` | — | — |
| Close Tab | `tabs.close` | `CloseContent` | `Ctrl+W` | `⌘W` |
| Select Next Tab | `tabs.next` | `NextTab` | `Ctrl+Shift+]` | `⇧⌘]` / `⌃Right` |
| Select Previous Tab | `tabs.previous` | `PreviousTab` | `Ctrl+Shift+[` | `⇧⌘[` / `⌃Left` |
| Project Tool Window | `tool-window.project` | `ActivateProjectToolWindow` | `Alt+1` | `⌘1` |
| Hide All Tool Windows | `tool-window.hide-all` | `HideAllWindows` | `Ctrl+Shift+F12` | `⇧⌘F12` |
| Go to Line:Column… | `editor.goto-line` | `GotoLine` | `Ctrl+L` | `⌘L` |
| Find… | `editor.find` | `Find` | `Ctrl+F` | `⌘F` |
| Find Next | `editor.find-next` | `FindNext` | `Ctrl+G` | `⌘G` |
| Find Previous | `editor.find-previous` | `FindPrevious` | `Alt+Shift+G` | `⇧⌘G` |
| Extend Selection | `editor.extend-selection` | `EditorSelectWord` | `Alt+Up` | `⌥Up` |
| Shrink Selection | `editor.shrink-selection` | `EditorUnSelectWord` | `Alt+Down` | `⌥Down` |
| Collapse | `editor.fold` | `CollapseRegion` | `Ctrl+Num-` / `Ctrl+-` | `⌘Num-` / `⌘-` |
| Expand | `editor.unfold` | `ExpandRegion` | `Ctrl+Num+` / `Ctrl+=` | `⌘Num+` / `⌘=` |
| Collapse All | `editor.fold-all` | `CollapseAllRegions` | `Ctrl+Shift+Num-` / `Ctrl+Shift+-` | `⇧⌘Num-` / `⇧⌘-` |
| Expand All | `editor.unfold-all` | `ExpandAllRegions` | `Ctrl+Shift+Num+` / `Ctrl+Shift+=` | `⇧⌘Num+` / `⇧⌘=` |
| Go to Declaration | `navigate.goto-declaration` | `GotoDeclaration` | `Ctrl+B` / `Ctrl+Click` | `⌘B` / `⌘Click` / `Middle Click` |
| Back | `navigate.back` | `Back` | `Ctrl+Alt+Left` / `Ctrl+[` / `Mouse Back` | `⌘[` / `⌥⌘Left` / `Mouse Back` |

| Search Everywhere | `navigate.search-everywhere` | `SearchEverywhere` | `Shift Shift` | `Shift Shift` |
| Go to Class… | `navigate.goto-class` | `GotoClass` | `Ctrl+O` | `⌘O` |
| Go to File… | `navigate.goto-file` | `GotoFile` | `Ctrl+Shift+O` | `⇧⌘O` |

| Find Usages | `navigate.find-usages` | `FindUsages` | `Alt+F7` | `⌥F7` |
| Show Usages | `navigate.show-usages` | `ShowUsages` | `Ctrl+Alt+F7` | `⌥⌘F7` |
